title: Which guidance applies to Link Permissions and Expiry?

question.author: member_077
question.body: There seem to be different descriptions of link permissions and expiry. What is the maintained CloudBox guidance?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Sharing Files and Folders documentation says: Changing a file's permissions applies to every link that points to it. Links to folders inherit the folder's permissions. Share links can carry an optional expiration date and an optional password. Expired links stop working immediately, and you can revoke any link at any time from the Shared links panel. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
